headline: Last session: Sensex rallies 1,718 points to 81,028 as Nifty reclaims 25,000 mark

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.

why: Indian equity markets bucked a global tech rout to post their best weekly performance in 6 years.
Bulls maintained momentum on D-Street led by broad-based buying across financial and auto stocks.
Positive market sentiment continued ahead of the upcoming Samvat 2083 and Diwali festivities.
Nifty successfully reclaimed the key psychological level of 25,000 during Friday's trading session.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, Sensex surged 1,718 points to close at 81,028, while Nifty finished at 25,030.
Prestige Group acquired a 100% stake in Allure Developers for Rs 524 crore to develop a housing project in Noida.
Amber Enterprises subsidiary IL JIN Electronics filed a DRHP with SEBI to raise Rs 2,500 crore via IPO.
Hindustan Coca-Cola Holdings filed DRHP papers with SEBI to raise funds through an initial public offering.
summary:
On the last trading session, Indian markets posted major gains with the Sensex jumping 1,718 points and Nifty reclaiming 25,000.
Indian stocks bucked global selloffs to register their strongest weekly performance in six years.
The stock market is closed today for the weekend and will reopen on Sunday, 8 November.
